presidential_approval.note: Approval declining amid Iran conflict (started early March) and tariff fallout. Reuters/Ipsos 36% is new second-term low. RCP average down ~1pt from mid-March.

economy.gdp_source: BEA Q4 2025 second estimate (revised down from 2.3% advance estimate on 3/13/26). Full year 2025: 2.1%. Third estimate due 4/9/26.
economy.consumer_sentiment_source: University of Michigan, March 2026 final (released 3/27, down from 55.5 prelim and 56.6 Feb final). Current conditions 55.8, expectations 51.7. Year-ahead inflation expectations surged to 3.8% (from 3.4% prelim). Decline driven by Iran conflict and energy cost spike.
economy.unemployment_source: BLS, February 2026 (nonfarm payrolls -92k; up from 4.1% in January). Includes Kaiser Permanente strike impact. March report due 4/3/26.
